positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Focusing on Assistant Quality: measuring, figuring out where, how, and why things are failing for some people (or all people).  Then figure out what it takes to get it fixed and make it happen.

Managed a small team focused on Product Inclusion and Equity for Google Assistant.  Evaluating 
how well Assistant works for different demographics in aggregate.

Worked on family-focused features for Google Assistant team: developed and launched delightful alarms and timers ("Set a 10 minute pizza timer").  Helped make Notes and Lists more family-friendly.

Worked on Federated Learning ML toolkit for on-device learning and inference on Android.
Helped develop ML gesture recognition model for Android Wear.  Integrated movement recognition with the rest of the Android OS and created the interactive tutorial teaching users how to use the feature.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description: Working with Dr. Alaa Ahmed studying and modeling human movement.  Built an inexpensive virtual reality system using Open Source libraries, Oculus Rift, and a Kinect.  Created an experiment to probe the effect of virtual heights (postural threat) on risky economic decision making.  Made an Open Source library and user interface for using Wii Balance Boards for physiology research and education.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant/Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed and tested techniques using the Open Dynamics Engine (ODE) to compute inverse kinematics and inverse dynamics.  These techniques use the ODE constraint solver as an implicit PD controller to push or pull a character model into position with external or internal forces.
Created a virtual reality environment in C++ for interactive experiments studying human movement.  The virtual environment combined 3d graphics rendered with OpenGL to an nVis head-mounted display with a Phasespace motion-capture system and simulated physics (ODE).  Other sensors integrated into the system included a 32-channel wireless EMG (Konigsberg Instruments) and Wii-motes and Balance Boards.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developing and testing research software for genealogical database work and UAV interface control.
